reason: The chasing and retyping is exactly my pain, but a Google Sheet with categories does not get me into Jurnal or Accurate, and without invoice number, PPN and NPWP I still have to retype every receipt anyway. I might play with the 30 free documents, but I would not pay $19 a month out of my own pocket for a sheet I then have to redo.
objection: It does not export to Jurnal or Accurate and has no invoice number, VAT (PPN) or NPWP fields, so it does not remove the retyping, it just moves it. And 100 documents is one or two clients for me, so the real price is the $35 or $79 tier, which I cannot afford on what I earn.
would_change_my_mind: If it pulled out invoice number, PPN and NPWP and gave me a file I can import straight into Jurnal or Accurate, so the retyping actually stops.
